ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 75:25 ratio of low-intensity (black/dark-grey) to high-intensity (white/light-grey) pixels across the visible ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Central and lower regions consist of solid low-intensity black pixels. Upper-distal regions feature high-contrast grey/white mottling. Discrete, small low-intensity circular spots (approx. 5-10 pixels in diameter) are mapped within the mottled regions of both lobes. Extreme distal tips contain contiguous high-intensity white/beige clusters.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: V-shaped depression with a calculated internal angle of approximately 48 degrees and a bounding-box depth of roughly 15% of the visible lobe height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, low-amplitude (2-5 pixel) serrations along the medial trailing edge, transitioning to high-amplitude (10-25 pixel), irregular jagged peaks at the distal margins corresponding to barnacle clusters.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Sigmoidal curve transitioning from concave at the median notch to convex at the mid-point, terminating in a sharp upward-lateral sweep at the tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Dense, roughly circular high-contrast white pixel clusters (barnacle colonies) concentrated heavily on the outer distal 10% of both fluke lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Subtle, near-vertical low-intensity linear streaks visible on the mottled grey upper-section of the right fluke lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive peripheral barnacle colonization (Coronula species morphology) on both distal tips; small circular hyper-pigmented scars present in the mottled regions of both lobes.
other_distinctive_markers: A small black and white seabird is visible in the background, positioned just below the lower margin of the right fluke lobe.
